met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Firozpur, Karnal, Hardoi, centre of Depression over north Jharkhand and adjoining southwest Bihar & southeast Uttar Pradesh, Digha and thence southeastwards to Northeast Bay of Bengal.
A trough runs from Central parts of North Uttar Pradesh to the cyclonic circulation associated with the depression over north Jharkhand and adjoining southwest Bihar & southeast Uttar Pradesh at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Punjab & neighbourhood persists and now seen at 5.8 km above mean sea level with a trough aloft at its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level runs roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 30°N.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Northeast Rajasthan & neighbourhoodat 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The trough now runs from the cyclonic circulation associated with the Depression over north Jharkhand and adjoining southwest Bihar & southeast Uttar Pradesh to South Gujarat Region across Madhya Pradesh at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Central Assam & neighbourhoodextends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
